active_mission.title: Build and validate persistent 11-agent Hixton swarm
active_mission.objective: Create a durable specialist swarm that prevents cross-component regressions, detects stalled work, reopens failed patches, and never declares a bot change complete without technical QA and governance review.
constraints: Respect AGENTS.md bootstrap restriction before modifying files outside agent_memory/.
Do not alter live trading enablement or place real orders.
Do not optimize strategy merely to make historical numbers look better.
acceptance: All 11 role contracts exist and are non-overlapping.
Dispatcher and meta-orchestrator responsibilities are separate.
Repair-loop and downstream invalidation rules are explicit.
Existing single-agent starter limitations are documented.
After bootstrap, local swarm runner is implemented and regression-tested.
First system test uses the USDT-to-USDC migration incident as a regression scenario.

queued_missions.title: USDC 3x80 early-loss-path improvement
queued_missions.objective: After swarm infrastructure is validated, investigate and improve the fresh USDC portfolio path that reaches the early drawdown halt, using time-separated validation and without simply disabling risk protection.
